caption: The drawing depicts a single white or light gray ceramic or porcelain pitcher prominently placed in the center of the composition. The pitcher has a wide, rounded body that tapers inward toward the neck and flares out at the rim, forming a pronounced spout. It features a large, ornate handle that curves gracefully from the upper rim to attach near the base of the neck, with a small decorative element at the join. The base of the pitcher is wide and circular, with a raised, tiered pedestal. The image is rendered in a realistic manner with shading to suggest depth, light, and curvature, and the background is blank and unadorned, accentuating the form of the pitcher. The overall color palette is monochromatic, consisting of various shades of gray.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
